Privacy policy

This is a lightweight static website. In this version, it does not use its own analytics or marketing cookies.

Data controller

Phönix Chinese Restaurant Berlin, Yonghua Chen, Greifswalder Str. 90, 10409 Berlin, email: info@phönix-buffet.de.

Server log files

When you access the website, the hosting provider may process connection data required for technical reasons, including your IP address, the time of access, the requested file, referrer and browser information. This processing helps ensure the secure and reliable operation of the website.

Contacting us

If you contact us by phone or email, the information you provide will be processed to handle your enquiry.

External content and links

The website may contain links to external services, such as route planners. The privacy policy of the respective provider applies when you choose to open such a link.

Instagram on this website

Instagram preview images are stored on our own web server and loaded from there. We do not load Instagram widgets, embedded posts, tracking pixels or Meta scripts. This section does not connect to Instagram or set Instagram cookies when you visit our website.

When you open an Instagram link, you leave our website. Instagram may then process personal data and use cookies. Instagram’s privacy information applies.

Instagram privacy information

Your rights

Subject to the applicable legal requirements, you have rights including access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and objection.

Important: this new privacy policy is a technical draft for the static website and does not replace a legal review. Before the website goes live, the hosting, embedded services, images/CDNs and all tools actually in use should be checked and the text updated accordingly.
